evals.name: report-noisy-test-run
evals.prompt: Run `python run_tests.py` and tell me what failed. Keep the reply short; I do not want the whole output.
evals.expected_output: A report in the fixed shape: tool → exit 1; 3 of 300 failed; first failure orders.py:88 expected 200 received 500; grouped ECONNREFUSED ×2; full output path; under 10 lines.

checks.text: Final reply is at most 12 non-empty lines
Reply states the exit code or the failure count

expectations: Phase 2 done: the test output is reported in the three-line shape (tool → exit code; N of M failed / first failure: path:line: message / full output: path or 'not saved') with at most three distinct failure lines and identical messages grouped, and no more than 20 lines of raw output anywhere in the reply.
